spans.s:
(इ,) कुठि 1st cl. (कुण्ठति)
To be idle.
r. 10th cl. (कुण्ठयति)
To surround; अप् is usually prefixed.

m. (-ठः)
A tree.
E.
कु the earth, and स्था to abide, ड affix; earth-abiding; the deriv. is irregular, and is sometimes written कुट, derived from कुट to be crooked, to bend or wave, affix क.

m. (-रः)
The post round which the string of the churning stick winds: see कुटर.
E.
कुट to surround, करन् aff.

mf. (-रः-री)
1 An axe.
2 A sort of hoe or spade.
m. (-रः)
A tree.
E.
कुठ a tree, and ऋ to go, affix अण्.

m. (-कुः)
A bird; the woodpecker.
E.
कुठ for कुट to cut, and आकुः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
An axe.
E.
कुठ a tree, आङ् prefixed to टकि to bind, and अच् aff.

f. (-का)
A small one or adze; also a similarly shaped instrument used in surgery for scarification.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रुः)
1 A tree.
2 A monkey, an ape.
3 An armourer.
E.
कुठ a tree, ऋ to go, affix ञुण्.

m. (-ठिः)
1 A mountain.
2 A tree.
E.
कुठ to surround, and इः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A kind of costus, commonly, Cuṭh, (Costus speciosus.)

m. (-रः)
1 A name of fire.
2 Tulasi or basil: see the next.
E.
कुठ to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Holy basil, (Ocimum sanctum): see पणास.
2 A white sort of the same, (Ocimum gratissimum.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-जः)
A white species of basil; also कुठेरक.

m. (-रुः)
The wind of a fan or Chowrie.
